title: Hugging Face library telemetry is on
explanation: huggingface_hub sends usage telemetry to Hugging Face by default. Telemetry is off only when HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY (or DO_NOT_TRACK) is set, or offline mode is on.

evidence.detail: huggingface_hub 0.26.2 installed; not disabled in the image (none of DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1|true|yes|on, DO_NOT_TRACK=1|true|yes|on, HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1|true|yes|on, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1|true|yes|on, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1|true|yes|on)

fix: Set HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 (and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1) in the image environment.
